description: Life insurance balance-sheet skeleton using all 150 user-supplied unique US-GAAP concepts for SIC 6311. The supplied MetLife presentation guides broad families; insurance obligations, reinsurance, separate accounts and measurement alternatives retain distinct scopes. This classification does not prescribe arithmetic or complete coverage for an individual issuer.
classification_notes: All supplied concepts appear exactly once. The supplied inventory defines coverage; no company-frequency threshold is inferred.
MetLife is a presentation reference for the industry. The reference presentation totals, zero displays and net debt do not establish taxonomy equivalence, fact signs, completeness or calculations.
Hierarchy and total node kinds do not imply addition. Alternative totals, valuation bases and subsets require reconciliation before aggregation.
General-account investments and separate-account assets remain distinct; their corresponding liabilities are not automatically netted against assets.
Gross and reinsurance-net insurance liabilities are alternatives. Reinsurance assets, allowances and funds-held balances require matched scope and are not automatically offset against liabilities.
DAC, VOBA and their combined aggregate overlap; market-risk-benefit carrying positions differ from exposure measures.
No maturity classification is inferred for unclassified tags. Explicitly current and noncurrent concepts retain their taxonomy scope.
Preferred and redeemable interests require redemption-term review. Temporary equity remains separate from permanent equity.
Contra identifies valuation or equity deduction balances, not a universal instruction to negate source values. Review dimensions, measurement and sign presentation before production use.

metadata_contract.period_type: Verified against taxonomy periodType for all concepts.
metadata_contract.unit_type: Verified monetary, shares and per-share taxonomy item types.
metadata_contract.contra: True for identified credit allowances, accumulated depreciation/amortization and treasury stock cost. Source-fact signs require separate review.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against official 2026 schema and documentation. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy versions and units.

sources.description: 150 unique user-supplied us-gaap concepts for SIC 6311, compared with facts_by_statement.json BS inventory.
Official FASB US GAAP 2026 schema and documentation.

nodes.label: Total assets
nodes.classification_note: Asset presentation is unclassified except where a concept explicitly specifies maturity. Children are overlapping reporting scopes, not an automatic sum.

children.label: Cash and cash equivalents
children.classification_note: Cash is a subset of cash and cash equivalents; select the reported scope without adding both.

children.label: Investment assets
children.classification_note: The reported investment total may include the portfolios below; select totals or reconciled detail. No unsupported interest-earning asset subtotal is invented.

children.label: Reported investment aggregate
children.classification_note: The total is a reporting alternative to its portfolio detail.

concepts.name: us-gaap:Investments
concepts.review_reason: Investment aggregate coverage can include multiple portfolios, accrued amounts or assets measured on different bases; reconcile its issuer-specific components before using detail.

children.label: Fixed-income investments
children.classification_note: AFS and trading debt are generally fair-value portfolios; HTM is a different carrying basis. AFS tags differ in accrued-interest scope. Do not add alternative AFS balances.

children.label: AFS Debt Securities, Excluding Accrued Interest
Equity security investments
children.classification_note: Current FV-NI investments can be included in the current-and-noncurrent total. Investments without readily determinable fair values use a distinct measurement scope.

children.label: FV-NI equity securities: current and noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNi
concepts.review_reason: The taxonomy restricts this FV-NI balance to current investments; it is not interchangeable with the current-and-noncurrent FV-NI total.

children.label: Equity Securities Without Readily Determinable Fair Value Amount
Affiliate and equity-method investments
children.classification_note: Equity-method amounts can be included in broader affiliate, subsidiary, associate and joint venture balances. Review consolidation scope.

children.label: Investments In Affiliates Subsidiaries Associates And Joint Ventures

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentsInAffiliatesSubsidiariesAssociatesAndJointVentures
concepts.review_reason: Affiliate investment coverage is broader than equity-method investments and may reflect unconsolidated or parent-only reporting; establish consolidation and measurement basis.

children.label: Real estate investments
children.classification_note: Real estate investments are net of accumulated depreciation and can include joint ventures. Joint-venture and held-for-sale balances can overlap this aggregate; accumulated depreciation must not be deducted again from a net balance.

children.label: Real estate investments, net of depreciation
Mortgage, policy and other loans
children.classification_note: Mortgage, policy and broader financing-receivable views may overlap. Reconcile loan class, accrued interest, gross/net scope and allowance before selecting balances.

children.label: Mortgage loans
children.classification_note: Commercial-and-consumer net mortgage loans already deduct reserves; the other real-estate loan tag requires gross/net scope review.

children.label: Mortgage Loans On Real Estate Commercial And Consumer Net

concepts.name: us-gaap:MortgageLoansOnRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: The definition does not establish the same net-of-reserve scope as the commercial-and-consumer mortgage net tag; verify the issuer’s allowance treatment.

children.label: Policy loans
children.classification_note: Policy loans secured by insurance contracts have separate before-allowance and carrying-value concepts. These are alternative measurements of overlapping assets.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LoansInsurancePolicy
concepts.review_reason: This is a before-allowance policy-loan balance including specified deferred interest and fees; reconcile it to the carrying amount reported as PolicyLoansReceivable.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PolicyLoansReceivable
concepts.review_reason: The carrying amount can overlap the separately supplied before-allowance policy-loan tag; identify allowance and accrued-interest coverage.

children.label: Other notes and financing receivables
children.classification_note: Net notes and broad financing receivables can include mortgage or other investment loan classes. Before/after-allowance financing receivables exclude accrued interest and net investment in leases; match portfolio and measurement scope.

children.label: Financing Receivables, Net, Excluding Accrued Interest
Financing Receivables, Before Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest
Loan credit allowances
children.classification_note: Real-estate and broad financing allowances can overlap. Do not deduct an allowance from a net loan balance again.

children.label: Allowance For Loan And Lease Losses Real Estate

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForLoanAndLeaseLossesRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Real-estate loan reserves can overlap the broader financing receivable allowance; do not deduct from a mortgage amount already reported net.

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLosses
concepts.review_reason: This allowance can cover mortgage and other financing assets; identify portfolio coverage before applying it to the narrower real-estate loan balance.

children.label: Financing Receivable Allowance, Excluding Accrued Interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest
concepts.review_reason: The allowance excludes accrued interest and can overlap other financing allowances; match its portfolio and interest scope to a gross receivable.

children.label: Other investment portfolios
children.classification_note: Short-term totals and residual short-term balances overlap; alternative and long-term investments may be included in other investments. Respect explicit maturity.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherShortTermInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Residual short-term investments may be included in ShortTermInvestments and must exclude separately selected security portfolios.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherLongTermInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Noncurrent residual investments may be included in OtherInvestments; establish maturity and asset-class exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AlternativeInvestment
concepts.review_reason: Alternative investments can overlap equity-method, real estate partnership and other investment balances; identify measurement and consolidation scope.

children.label: Resale agreement assets
children.classification_note: Reverse repo assets are lending balances and differ from repo borrowings and obligations to return securities collateral.

children.label: Securities Purchased Under Agreements To Resell
AFS debt credit allowances
children.classification_note: The allowance excluding accrued interest can overlap the broader AFS allowance. AFS allowances explain valuation and are not additional assets.

children.label: AFS debt credit allowance, excluding accrued interest
Accrued investment income
children.classification_note: Accrued investment income may be excluded from security or loan carrying amounts; reconcile the issuer’s accrued-interest presentation.

children.label: Premium and other receivables
children.classification_note: Both premium-only carrying amounts and premium-and-other-receivable totals are net of doubtful-account allowances. The narrower premium amount may be included in the total; do not deduct allowances again from net balances.

children.label: Allowance For Doubtful Accounts Premiums And Other Receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivable
concepts.review_reason: The receivable allowance may include exposures outside premiums; establish scope before combining with the premium-and-other-receivable allowance.

children.label: Reinsurance assets
children.classification_note: Gross recoverables and allowance reconcile to a net balance only on matching scope. IBNR and market-risk-benefit recoverables may be included in broader recoverables. Funds held are separately characterized assets.

children.label: Market risk benefit reinsurance recoverable, net
Funds Held Under Reinsurance Agreements Asset
Deferred insurance acquisition and inducement costs
children.classification_note: The DAC-plus-VOBA aggregate overlaps DAC and VOBA individually. Deferred sales inducements have a separate contract cost scope; do not equate them to generic intangible assets.

children.label: Deferred acquisition costs and VOBA, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsAndValueOfBusinessAcquired
concepts.review_reason: The reported net DAC-plus-VOBA aggregate overlaps both separately mapped balances; select the aggregate or a reconciled component presentation.

children.label: Market risk benefit assets
children.classification_note: Recognized asset positions are separate from recognized liability positions and net amounts at risk. Do not net across contracts without issuer evidence.

children.label: Derivative assets
children.classification_note: DerivativeAssets is fair value after effects of master netting arrangements, including positions not offset. Embedded derivative asset fair value may already be included in aggregate derivative assets or a host contract; establish recognition and collateral scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeAssets
concepts.review_reason: Fair value is after effects of master netting arrangements; determine embedded derivative inclusion and collateral presentation before combining with separate derivative asset disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EmbeddedDerivativeFairValueOfEmbeddedDerivativeAsset
concepts.review_reason: Embedded derivative asset fair value may be included in a host contract or aggregate derivatives; confirm separate balance-sheet recognition and avoid double counting.

children.label: Separate account assets
children.classification_note: Separate-account assets are recognized assets; the corresponding separate-account liabilities are not deducted from this asset balance.

children.label: Property and operating lease assets
children.classification_note: Owned PP&E and operating ROU assets are different asset classes but may be included in issuer aggregates. No maturity is inferred for unclassified balances.

children.label: Goodwill and intangible assets
children.classification_note: Goodwill-inclusive and goodwill-exclusive totals, residual intangibles and amortization disclosures can overlap VOBA and each other. Select matching scopes.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherIntangibleAssetsNet
concepts.review_reason: Residual net intangible assets may overlap IntangibleAssetsNetExcludingGoodwill and VOBA; establish the issuer’s asset-class exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IntangibleAssetsNetIncludingGoodwill
concepts.review_reason: The goodwill-inclusive aggregate overlaps goodwill and other intangible balances; determine whether acquired insurance business value is included.

children.label: Tax assets
children.classification_note: Net deferred tax assets reflect valuation allowances and jurisdictional netting. IncomeTaxesReceivable explicitly covers current refunds; IncomeTaxReceivable has no explicit maturity restriction. They can overlap and must not be added as independent tax assets.

children.label: Income tax refunds receivable: maturity unspecified

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxReceivable
concepts.review_reason: The tax-refund receivable definition has no explicit maturity restriction; establish issuer maturity and overlap with the separately supplied current IncomeTaxesReceivable.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: This tax-refund receivable is explicitly due within one year or the operating cycle; it can be included in the other tax-refund balance and must not be added blindly.

children.label: Other assets and deposit assets
children.classification_note: Deposit assets are assets transferred as security, not customer deposit liabilities. Other assets are a residual and can include separately disclosed classes.

nodes.label: Total liabilities
nodes.classification_note: Liability totals and their presentation families are not additive by hierarchy; gross and reinsurance-net insurance obligations remain alternatives.

children.label: Insurance contract liabilities
children.classification_note: Future benefits, claims, policyholder deposits and funds have different definitions. The reported benefit-and-claims aggregate overlaps narrower liability balances.

children.label: Reported benefits and claims aggregate
children.classification_note: The combined insurance obligation is an alternative to a reconciled breakdown of future benefits and claims.

children.label: Future policy benefits and unpaid claims aggregate

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitsAndUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpense
concepts.review_reason: This aggregate includes future-policy-benefit and claim-related obligations, which are also mapped separately; determine the exact included liability classes.

children.label: Future policy benefit alternatives
children.classification_note: Before-reinsurance and after-reinsurance measures must not be added. Gross liability and separately recognized reinsurance asset presentation differs from a net reserve disclosure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitAfterReinsurance
concepts.review_reason: The after-reinsurance measure is an alternative to the gross liability plus separately recognized reinsurance recoverables; do not combine both presentations.

children.label: Claims and claims adjustment liabilities
children.classification_note: Unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense net explicitly deducts estimated reinsurance recoveries. The other claim liability represents estimated ultimate settlement costs. Select a consistent gross or reinsurance-net presentation.

children.label: Liability For Claims And Claims Adjustment Expense
Unpaid claims and adjustment expenses, net of reinsurance

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilityForUnpaidClaimsAndClaimsAdjustmentExpenseNet
concepts.review_reason: This claims reserve is net of estimated reinsurance recoveries and includes IBNR; do not combine it with a gross claims reserve and the same reinsurance assets.

children.label: Policyholder deposits and funds
children.classification_note: Contract deposits, guaranteed-interest contracts and policyholder funds are different coverage views. Funds can include unpaid policy dividends; do not sum overlapping categories.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PolicyholderFunds
concepts.review_reason: Includes unpaid policy dividends and other participating-business amounts while excluding future benefits and claims; do not assume it equals policyholder contract deposits.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherPolicyholderFunds
concepts.review_reason: Other policyholder funds are a residual returnable-funds category that may be included in PolicyholderFunds; determine exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GuaranteedInterestContracts
concepts.review_reason: Guaranteed-interest contract liabilities may already be included in policyholder contract deposits; establish the product coverage before combining.

children.label: Unearned premiums
children.classification_note: Unearned premiums are not synonymous with future policy benefits or all policyholder contract deposits.

children.label: Reinsurance liabilities
children.classification_note: Reinsurance payable and funds held as security have distinct obligations and can be included in broader insurance liabilities; do not offset reinsurance assets automatically.

children.label: Funds Held Under Reinsurance Agreements Liability
Market risk benefit liabilities
children.classification_note: Recognized market-risk-benefit liability positions differ from net amounts at risk and separate asset positions.

children.label: Separate account liabilities
children.classification_note: Separate-account liability balances are distinct from general-account insurance obligations; related assets remain recognized separately.

children.label: Borrowings
children.classification_note: Combined debt, total long-term debt, noncurrent long-term debt, collateral and subordination views overlap. Surplus notes are GAAP liabilities even if statutory accounting includes them in surplus.

children.label: Reported debt total and maturity alternatives
children.classification_note: Combined long/short debt includes maturity components. LongTermDebt can include current maturities whereas LongTermDebtNoncurrent excludes them. Do not add alternative totals.

children.label: Debt instrument and collateral views
children.classification_note: Secured, subordinated, notes-payable and residual long-term debt can intersect maturity totals. These axes do not define additive peers.

children.label: Operating lease liabilities
children.classification_note: Operating lease liabilities differ from borrowings. Include in an analytical debt measure only under a separately defined policy.

children.label: Investment and collateral liabilities
children.classification_note: Repo borrowings, cash collateral received, obligations to return securities and broad investment-related liabilities differ in transaction and measurement scope and may overlap.

children.label: Securities Sold Under Agreements To Repurchase
Cash collateral received for securities loaned

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentRelatedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: This broad investment-related liability category can include repo, collateral and derivative liabilities already mapped elsewhere; establish its issuer-specific composition.

children.label: Derivative liability balances
children.classification_note: DerivativeLiabilities is fair value after effects of master netting arrangements, including positions not offset. Review overlap with insurance embedded derivatives and investment-related liability aggregates.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Fair value is after effects of master netting arrangements; establish overlap with insurance embedded derivatives and broad investment-related liabilities.

children.label: Income tax liabilities
children.classification_note: Gross and net deferred tax liabilities are alternatives; current accrued income taxes can be included in all-period accrued income taxes. Respect jurisdictional netting.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredIncomeTaxLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: This deferred tax liability measure precedes the jurisdictional asset offsets reflected in the net deferred tax liability alternative.

children.label: Accrued Income Taxes, Current and Noncurrent
Other liabilities and deferred revenue
children.classification_note: Current deferred revenue and combined accounts payable/accruals can be included in other liabilities; residual exclusions require issuer presentation.

children.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current and Noncurrent

nodes.label: Total equity including noncontrolling interests
nodes.classification_note: Total permanent equity includes parent and noncontrolling interests; temporary equity is presented separately and may require a separate balance-sheet reconciliation term.

children.label: Equity attributable to the parent
children.classification_note: Parent equity components are presentation families; common/preferred alternatives and treasury amounts must be reconciled before calculating equity.

children.label: Common share capital
children.classification_note: Issued and outstanding common stock values differ in treasury share coverage; select the legal-capital basis matching the issuer.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommonStockValueOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Outstanding common stock value may differ from issued common stock value because of treasury shares; reconcile the issuer’s legal-capital presentation.

children.label: Additional paid-in capital
children.classification_note: Common-stock APIC is a subset or alternative to all-class APIC; do not add both.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AdditionalPaidInCapitalCommonStock
concepts.review_reason: Common-stock-specific additional paid-in capital may be included in the all-class APIC total; do not add both amounts.

children.label: Preferred share capital candidates
children.classification_note: Preferred carrying amounts require classification by redemption terms; their position here is provisional and does not presume permanent-equity treatment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockValue
concepts.review_reason: Preferred stock carrying values require redemption and settlement terms to determine permanent-equity, temporary-equity or liability presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockValueOutstanding
concepts.review_reason: Outstanding preferred carrying value can overlap PreferredStockValue and can require temporary-equity classification depending on redemption terms.

children.label: Retained earnings
children.classification_note: Retained earnings or accumulated deficit is an equity balance, not current-period net income.

children.label: Treasury stock
children.classification_note: Treasury stock cost reduces equity. Common-only and all-class amounts overlap; preserve source signs and avoid applying a deduction twice.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TreasuryStockCommonValue
concepts.review_reason: Common treasury stock cost may be included in the all-class treasury stock balance; select matching share-class coverage.

children.label: Accumulated other comprehensive income
children.classification_note: After-tax AOCI total includes separately reported AFS, currency and future-benefit discount-rate components. Select total or reconciled detail, not both.

children.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
AOCI: foreign currency translation, after tax
AOCI: future policy benefit discount-rate changes, after tax

nodes.label: Temporary equity and redeemable noncontrolling interests
nodes.classification_note: Temporary equity is separate from permanent parent and noncontrolling equity. The total can include redeemable NCI; do not add the total and this component.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterests
concepts.review_reason: The temporary-equity aggregate can contain redeemable NCI and preferred interests; reconcile coverage and keep it separate from permanent equity.

children.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest Equity Carrying Amount

concepts.name: us-gaap:RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCarryingAmount
concepts.review_reason: Redeemable noncontrolling interests may be included in the temporary-equity aggregate; identify redemption terms and exclude permanent NCI overlap.

nodes.label: Total liabilities and equity
nodes.classification_note: Match the issuer’s inclusion of temporary equity and noncontrolling interests when reconciling liabilities and equity to assets; no calculation is prescribed.

nodes.label: Supplementary balance-sheet disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Share terms, valuation alternatives, portfolio subsets and risk exposures are retained separately from primary carrying balances.

children.label: Investment measurement alternatives
children.classification_note: Cost, amortized cost and disclosed fair value are alternative measurements rather than additional investment assets. Match interest and credit-loss allowance scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AvailableForSaleDebtSecuritiesAmortizedCostBasis
concepts.review_reason: AFS debt amortized cost differs from fair-value carrying amounts; establish accrued-interest and allowance coverage.

children.label: AFS Amortized Cost, Before Allowance, Excluding Interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: AFS amortized cost excludes accrued interest and precedes credit-loss allowances; do not substitute it for the net or fair-value balance.

children.label: AFS Amortized Cost, After Allowance, Excluding Interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
concepts.review_reason: AFS amortized cost is after allowance and excludes accrued interest; the main AFS carrying value has a different measurement basis.

children.label: Held To Maturity Securities Fair Value

concepts.name: us-gaap:HeldToMaturitySecuritiesFairValue
concepts.review_reason: HTM fair value is a disclosure measurement distinct from the amortized-cost carrying balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquitySecuritiesFvNiCost
concepts.review_reason: FV-NI equity investment cost is not the recognized fair-value carrying amount.

children.label: Trading debt and FV-NI equity securities: cost

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesTradingAndEquitySecuritiesFvNiCost
concepts.review_reason: Combined trading-debt and FV-NI equity cost overlaps separate portfolio cost disclosures and differs from fair-value carrying amounts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TradingSecuritiesDebtAmortizedCost
concepts.review_reason: Trading debt amortized cost is a disclosure measurement, not the fair-value trading investment carrying balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentsFairValueDisclosure
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method investment fair value is a disclosure alternative to its equity-method carrying amount.

children.label: Other fair-value disclosures
children.classification_note: Fair-value disclosures can cover loan and other carrying balances already mapped in primary sections. They are not incremental assets or liabilities.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LoansReceivableFairValueDisclosure
concepts.review_reason: Disclosed loan fair values can include mortgage, financing and policy loans and must not replace their carrying amounts without measurement review.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAssetsFairValueDisclosure
concepts.review_reason: This is disclosed fair value for other assets, not their balance-sheet carrying amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherLiabilitiesFairValueDisclosure
concepts.review_reason: This is disclosed fair value for other liabilities, not their balance-sheet carrying amount.

children.label: Restricted and trust-held asset subsets
children.classification_note: Legal restrictions or trust custody do not make portfolio subsets additional recognized assets. Reconcile them to the investment and cash carrying balances.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetsHeldInTrust
concepts.review_reason: Trust-held assets may remain within the recognized investment portfolio; legal restriction does not establish an additional asset to add to the balance sheet.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleRestricted
concepts.review_reason: Restricted AFS debt is a portfolio subset potentially included in the main AFS carrying balance; do not add it as another investment category.

children.label: Insurance risk exposures
children.classification_note: Net amount at risk is an exposure measure distinct from recognized market-risk-benefit asset, liability and reinsurance recoverable balances.

children.label: Market risk benefits: net amount at risk

concepts.name: us-gaap:MarketRiskBenefitNetAmountAtRisk
concepts.review_reason: Guaranteed benefits in excess of account balances measure exposure, not the recognized market-risk-benefit asset or liability.

children.label: Share counts
children.classification_note: Authorized, issued and outstanding shares are distinct instant counts; common treasury shares explain a potential issued/outstanding difference but are not an equity dollar balance.

children.label: Share par and liquidation terms
children.classification_note: Par values are per-share contractual terms. Liquidation preference tags represent the excess over par or stated value, per share or aggregate; they are not preferred carrying values.

children.label: Common Stock Par or Stated Value per Share
Preferred Stock Par or Stated Value per Share
Preferred liquidation preference excess per share

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockLiquidationPreference
concepts.review_reason: This per-share term is the excess of liquidation preference over par or stated value; it is not a preferred-stock carrying balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockLiquidationPreferenceValue
concepts.review_reason: This aggregate excess of liquidation preference over par or stated value is a contractual term, not a carrying amount.

children.label: AOCI tax and commitments
children.classification_note: AOCI tax is not another after-tax equity component. Commitment and contingency disclosures need recognition context and are not assumed liabilities.

children.label: Tax Allocated to AOCI Attributable to Parent

concepts.name: us-gaap:AociTaxAttributableToParent
concepts.review_reason: This AOCI tax balance is a tax component, not an additional after-tax equity component; reconcile its tax presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CommitmentsAndContingencies
concepts.review_reason: Commitment and contingency disclosures do not establish a recognized balance-sheet liability without the filing’s recognition context.
